task.instruction: Plan the investigation. Treat the supplied records as the complete synthetic evidence set and make one selection for each declared decision.
task.deliverable: An investigation plan with scope, sequence, and record citations. Cite the named evidence references and do not list mutually incompatible selections.

evidence.content: The tray log notes a cracked liner, while the drain sketch shows a common pinch point downstream.
A constructed greenhouse bench has standing water below one tray and a shared drain channel feeding three benches.
This synthetic plan record for case-research-a27 is bounded to the named observation and constraint. A valid conclusion must distinguish them, cite both, and avoid an unstated factual claim.

A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.
